broad_wall_258.name: Broad Wall
broad_wall_258.what: A thick section of Jerusalem's wall, restored in Nehemiah's day and passed by a choir at the wall's dedication.
broad_wall_258.today: Likely the thick wall uncovered in the Jewish Quarter of Jerusalem's Old City.
key: The builders restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall (Nehemiah 3).
At the wall's dedication, one thanksgiving choir passed the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall (Nehemiah 12).

calneh_269.name: Calneh
calneh_269.what: A city named in Nimrod's kingdom in Shinar, and a city Amos held up as a warning to complacent Israel.
calneh_269.today: Exact site unknown; Amos's Calneh was likely in northern Syria.
key: Nimrod's kingdom began with Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in the land of Shinar (Genesis 10).
Amos told Israel's complacent leaders to look at Calneh, Hamath, and Gath and compare their kingdoms (Amos 6).
Isaiah names Calno, likely the same northern city, among Assyria's conquests (Isaiah 10).

dinhabah_337.name: Dinhabah
dinhabah_337.what: The royal city of Bela son of Beor, the first king listed as reigning in Edom.
dinhabah_337.today: Exact site unknown; in ancient Edom, in southern Jordan.
key: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats that Bela's city was Dinhabah (1 Chronicles 1).

ebron_352.name: Ebron
ebron_352.what: A town on the boundary of Asher's inheritance in the far north, toward Sidon.
ebron_352.today: Exact site unknown; in western Galilee or southern Lebanon.
key: Asher's boundary included Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Sidon the Great (Joshua 19).
The boundary then turned to Ramah and the fortified city of Tyre (Joshua 19).

gath-hepher_443.name: Gath-hepher
gath-hepher_443.what: A town in Zebulun's territory in lower Galilee, hometown of the prophet Jonah son of Amittai.
gath-hepher_443.today: Likely Tel Gat Hefer, near Mashhad, northeast of Nazareth, Israel.
key: Zebulun's boundary passed eastward to Gath-hepher (Joshua 19).
Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher, foretold that Jeroboam II would restore Israel's border (2 Kings 14).

gudgodah_496.name: Gudgodah
gudgodah_496.what: A stopping place of Israel in the wilderness, between Moserah and Jotbathah.
gudgodah_496.today: Exact site unknown; likely the same camp as Hor-haggidgad.
key: From Moserah Israel journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks (Deuteronomy 10).
At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant (Deuteronomy 10).

japhia_623.name: Japhia
japhia_623.what: A town on the border of Zebulun's inheritance, near Daberath in lower Galilee.
japhia_623.today: Likely Yafa, just southwest of Nazareth, Israel.
key: From Chisloth-tabor the boundary went on to Daberath and up to Japhia (Joshua 19).
From there it passed eastward to Gath-hepher (Joshua 19).

moseroth_824.name: Moseroth
moseroth_824.what: A wilderness campsite of Israel, listed between Hashmonah and Bene-jaakan.
moseroth_824.today: Exact site unknown; likely the same place as Moserah.
key: Israel set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth (Numbers 33).
They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan (Numbers 33).

salamis_1016.name: Salamis
salamis_1016.what: A major city on the east coast of Cyprus, where Barnabas and Saul began preaching on their first missionary journey.
salamis_1016.today: Ruins near Famagusta, on the east coast of Cyprus.
key: At Salamis they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews (Acts 13).
John was with them to assist them (Acts 13).
They went through the whole island as far as Paphos (Acts 13).

sarid_1028.name: Sarid
sarid_1028.what: A town marking the southern boundary of Zebulun's inheritance.
sarid_1028.today: Possibly Tel Shadud, at the northern edge of the Jezreel Valley, Israel.
key: The territory of Zebulun reached as far as Sarid (Joshua 19).
From Sarid the boundary ran eastward toward Chisloth-tabor (Joshua 19).

ummah_1186.name: Ummah
ummah_1186.what: A town listed in the inheritance of the tribe of Asher.
ummah_1186.today: Exact site unknown; in Asher's territory in northern Israel.
key: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob are listed among Asher's twenty-two cities with their villages (Joshua 19).
This was the inheritance of the tribe of Asher according to its clans (Joshua 19).
